'''Dek Anorik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. After being captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] alongside his best friend on [[Gacerian]], Anorik was offered a deal in exchange for his freedom. Posing as a [[Prospector/Legends|prospector]], he would attempt to lure [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] and [[free-trader]]s to Gacerian by telling stories of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] wealth in [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]]. Those that Anorik lured to the planet would then by put to work [[Mining/Legends|mining]] the gems. To ensure Anorik's cooperation, his friend remained under Imperial protection on Gacerian.
